1.text: Intumwa na bene Data bari i Yudaya bumvise yuko abanyamahanga na bo bemeye ijambo ry'Imana,

2.text: nuko Petero azamutse i Yerusalemu abo mu bakebwe bajya impaka na we bati

4.text: Petero aterura amagambo, abibasobanurira uko bikurikirana ati

5.text: “Nari mu mudugudu witwa Yopa nsenga, nerekwa nko mu nzozi ikintu gisa n'umwenda w'umukomahasi kimanuka kivuye mu ijuru, gifashwe ku binyita bine kinzaho.

6.text: Ndagitumbira ndacyitegereza, mbonamo ibigenza amaguru ane byo mu isi, n'inyamaswa z'inkazi, n'ibikururuka hasi, n'ibiguruka mu kirere.

7.text: Kandi numva ijwi rimbwira riti ‘Haguruka Petero, ubage urye.’

8.text: Nanjye nti ‘Oya Mwami, kuko ikizira cyangwa igihumanya kitigeze kugera mu kanwa kanjye.’

9.text: Maze ijwi rivugiye mu ijuru rinsubiza ubwa kabiri riti ‘Ibyo Imana ihumanuye wibyita ibizira.’

10.text: Biba bityo gatatu, nuko byose birazamurwa bisubizwa mu ijuru.

11.text: Uwo mwanya abagabo batatu bavuye i Kayisariya bantumweho, bahagarara imbere y'inzu twari turimo.

12.text: Umwuka antegeka kujyana na bo ntaruhije nshidikanya. Kandi bene Data aba uko ari batandatu, turajyana twinjira mu nzu y'uwo mugabo.

13.text: Adutekerereza uko yabonye marayika mu nzu ye ahagaze amubwira ati ‘Tuma i Yopa, utumire Simoni wahimbwe Petero,

14.text: azakubwira amagambo azagukizanya n'abo mu rugo rwawe bose.’

15.text: Nteruye amagambo, Umwuka Wera arabamanukira nk'uko natwe yatumanukiye bwa mbere.

16.text: Nibuka rya jambo ry'Umwami Yesu, iryo yavugaga ati ‘Yohana yababatirishaga amazi, ariko mwebweho muzabatirishwa Umwuka Wera.’

17.text: Nuko ubwo Imana yabahaye impano ihwanye n'iyo natwe twahawe, ubwo twizeraga Umwami Yesu Kristo, ndi nde wo kuvuguruza Imana?”

18.text: Bumvise ibyo barihorera, bahimbaza Imana bati “Nuko noneho Imana ihaye n'abanyamahanga kwihana, kugira ngo na bo bahabwe ubugingo.”

19.text: Nuko abatatanijwe n'akarengane katewe n'ibya Sitefano bagera i Foyinike n'i Kupuro no muri Antiyokiya, ari nta wundi babwira ijambo keretse Abayuda bonyine.

20.text: Ariko bamwe muri bo b'i Kupuro n'ab'i Kurene bageze muri Antiyokiya, bavugana n'Abagiriki na bo bababwira ubutumwa bwiza bw'Umwami Yesu.

21.text: Ukuboko k'Umwami kuba kumwe na bo, abantu benshi barizera bahindukirira Umwami.

22.text: Iyo nkuru irumvikana igera mu matwi y'itorero ry'i Yerusalemu, batuma Barinaba muri Antiyokiya.

23.text: Asohoyeyo kandi abonye ubuntu bw'Imana aranezerwa, abahugura bose ati “Mugume mu Mwami Yesu mumaramaje mu mitima yanyu.”

24.text: Kuko Barinaba yari umunyangesonziza, wuzuye Umwuka Wera no kwizera. Abantu benshi bongererwa Umwami Yesu.

25.text: Bukeye avayo ajya i Taruso gushaka Sawuli,

26.text: amubonye amujyana mu Antiyokiya. Bamarayo umwaka wose baterana n'ab'Itorero, bigisha abantu benshi, kandi muri Antiyokiya ni ho abigishwa batangiriye kwitwa Abakristo.

27.text: Muri iyo minsi abahanuzi bava i Yerusalemu, bajya mu Antiyokiya.

28.text: Nuko umwe muri bo witwaga Agabo, arahaguruka arahanura abwirijwe n'Umwuka ati “Inzara nyinshi izatera mu isi yose.” (Ni yo yateye ku ngoma ya Kilawudiyo.)

29.text: Nuko abigishwa bagambirira koherereza bene Data batuye i Yudaya imfashanyo, umuntu wese akurikije ubutunzi bwe.

30.text: Babigenza batyo, babyoherereza abakuru babihaye Barinaba na Sawuli.
